initialization.origin: Gold checkpoint; phase 2 changed only the original rhythm head

data.follow_up_role: previously examined comparisons only; never used for training or selection
data.signal_contract: frozen first 10 seconds, six frontal leads, existing 0.5-45 Hz filter, resampling and per-lead z-score

selection.metric: mean fixed-nine-class macro-F1 across validation sources
selection.gold_preservation: SB and LBBB recall within 0.05 of Gold per source
selection.weak_class_preservation: SB, LBBB, RBBB, PAC, NSR recall no more than 0.05 below phase2 on source-class support >=20
selection.auxiliary_output_preservation: normalized RMSE <=0.15 for quality, biometrics and pathology outputs

execution: CEDIA Slurm GPU only; the follow-up predictions are evaluated after the validation-based selection is sealed
